title: Origin story: Ombrak
description: Ombrak was a tax-collector's clerk who discovered that shadows keep accounts — every debt, every secret, every unpaid thing casts one. He learned to read them, then to trade in them, and now he keeps the shadow-ledger for a whole underworld economy. Cross him, and your own shadow testifies.

title: Ability profile: Ombrak
description: Ranked abilities: Shadow-reading — rank 100/100; Accounting — rank 98/100; Memory — rank 96/100; Bargaining — rank 95/100; Stealth — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Ombrak
description: Powers: Shadows speak their owners' secrets to him; He trades in shadow-debt; His ledger binds like law.

title: Stamina feats: Ombrak
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Kept the books through three underworld wars; Traded without rest for a decade.

title: Crossover notes: Ombrak
description: Ombrak crosses naturally with: shadows, debts, the ledger of dark.

title: Design notes: Ombrak
description: Debt as magic; the shadow as witness.

title: Generator record: Ombrak
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Ombrak's database.
